summary: A check before entering a mode you cannot take back. Advises; never blocks.
invariants: ADVISES, NEVER BLOCKS — allowed is always true, asserted across all 121 rating combinations. Blocking an adult from their own app because a slider said so is paternalism at the moment someone has least patience for it, and it teaches people to lie to the slider.
LOCAL ONLY — no bus, no emitSync, no socket. A test greps the source.

NEVER LINKED TO CONTENT — there is deliberately no parameter for a message or rupture id, and a test asserts none survives. A self-report that can be quoted back at you is not a self-report, it is ammunition.
activation and regulation are asked SEPARATELY and are not opposites — calm-and-unreachable and lit-up-and-completely-here are both real states
thresholds are not thin: activation >= 8 or regulation <= 3. A 6 is a normal Tuesday.
a fresh reading means no re-asking; a reading older than 45 minutes is not "now"
§12.5 wentAheadAnyway is counted — advice that is always ignored is advice pitched wrong, not a person being stubborn
failure_modes: no storage -> throws, refuses to operate blind
unknown section or moment -> throws, listing the valid ones
empty or over-long entry -> throws, naming the limit
